content: For a scheduled outpatient consultation, bring the appointment reference and a current medication list. Arrive with a government-issued identification document if registration staff request it. [chunk_prep_01]

Fasting is required only when the appointment instructions explicitly say so. Follow the clinic instruction attached to the appointment; do not infer fasting requirements from the specialty alone. [chunk_fasting_01]
To cancel or reschedule, contact the outpatient desk before the appointment time and provide the appointment reference. Availability for a replacement slot is not guaranteed. [chunk_cancel_01]

Patients should arrive 20 minutes before the scheduled outpatient appointment for registration and check-in. Late arrival may require a new slot if the clinic cannot safely accommodate the remaining time. [chunk_checkin_01]
Administrative visiting rules vary by clinic area. The front desk can confirm the number of accompanying visitors permitted for the appointment. [chunk_visit_01]
